title: give registry entries ids and an unregister, without disturbing the existing tests
author: claude-author-session

checks.name: order-tests-verbatim
checks.pattern:
test\('starts empty', \(\) => \{?
  assert\.equal\(size\(\), 0\);?
\}\);[\s\S]*?test\('registers zeta first', \(\) => \{?
  register\('zeta'\);?
  assert\.equal\(size\(\), 1\);?
\}\);[\s\S]*?test\('registers alpha second', \(\) => \{?
  register\('alpha'\);?
  assert\.equal\(size\(\), 2\);?
\}\);[\s\S]*?test\('list keeps registration order', \(\) => \{?
  assert\.deepEqual\(list\(\), \['zeta', 'alpha'\]\);?
\}\);
